settings.heading: You wake up soft instead of tight
settings.body:
You moisturise every night and still wake up dry. That isn't you doing it wrong. Most creams sit on the surface and are gone hours before morning, which never mattered while your skin held onto moisture by itself. Korean red rice stays with your skin through the night instead.

You notice it when you wash your face, not when you put it on.

settings.heading: Built for the skin you have at 50, not scaled down from a younger woman's cream
settings.body:
It didn't happen slowly. Somewhere between 45 and 53 your skin got drier and thinner than it has ever been, and the routine that worked for twenty years quietly stopped working. Almost every night cream still assumes your skin does its own repair work overnight. Noula is formulated on the opposite assumption, which is why it is richer and why there is nothing harsh in it.

You will still look your age. You will just stop looking like you slept badly when you didn't.

settings.heading: There is actually enough red rice in it to matter
settings.body:
Most creams put their best ingredient in last, below the thickeners, in an amount you would need a lab to find. You have paid for that before without knowing. On Noula, red rice is one of the first things on the ingredient list, and that list is printed on the jar so you can check rather than take our word for it.

Korean women have used rice on their skin at every age for generations, not just in their twenties.

settings.heading: Rich enough for papery skin, and nothing left on your pillow
settings.body:
Crepey skin on the neck needs a rich cream, and rich creams end up on your pillowcase, so you pick which problem you would rather have. Noula uses shea butter for that kind of dryness and still absorbs overnight. Papery skin looks a good deal less papery once it is properly fed.

You can test the rest on the first night. Look at your pillowcase.

settings.heading: Gentle enough to use every single night
settings.body:
Retinol worked at 35. At 50 it stings, flakes and breaks you out, so you stopped, went back to something gentle, and gentle did nothing. Strong creams work by irritating your skin on purpose, and that is a trade your skin can no longer make. There are no retinoids and no exfoliating acids in Noula.

No sting, no flaking, no three weeks of getting worse first.

settings.heading: One step, at the end of the night you already have
settings.body:
You are not trying to look 25 and you do not want a ten step routine at 52. Noula goes on last, over whatever you already use, and there is nothing in it to clash with tretinoin, oestrogen cream or HRT. Plenty of women use it on the nights their prescription is too much for their skin.

The point is not thinking about your skin much at all.

settings.heading: 90 nights to decide, and the jar is yours either way
settings.body:
You have a drawer of creams that did nothing. Some of them were expensive. The real risk here was never the money, it is being let down again by something that sounded right.

So if your mornings are no different after three months, one email gets you a full refund and you keep the jar. You only pay for it if it works.
